lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular blobs posterior to the gill slits, organized into approximately six identifiable horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns along the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a discernible matrix pattern in the anterior mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity, characterized by light-reflecting upper edges and shadowed lower edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A cluster of approximately 8 to 10 high-luminance blobs distributed irregularly within the silhouette of the primary dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three prominent, nearly vertical, high-intensity white linear scars traversing the lateral spot pattern; noticeable jagged irregularities and white scarring on the posterior distal margin of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique, elongated, narrow vertical white markings resembling rope or entanglement scars that contrast sharply with the standard circular blob constellation.
